title: Extra Bet Blackjack
betGuide: Choose your ante. Bust It is optional
attackGuide: Having seen the up-card, you may add up to the ante
attackNotice: note: the dealer's second card comes after you decide
label.hidden: second card comes after the extra bet
tutorial.bet: Place the ante. Bust It is a side bet on the dealer busting
tutorial.attack: Seeing only the up-card, you may add up to the ante
tutorial.hands: Blackjack pays 1:1 here, not the usual 3:2
frontendHint.doubleAttackWeakUp: a weak up-card is what the extra bet is for
frontendHint.doubleAttackStrongUp: with the tens removed the dealer busts less, so declining is safer
frontendHint.doubleAttackStandPat: 17 or more is a standing hand
frontendHint.doubleAttackBorderline: an awkward total — it depends on the up-card
